decisions.text: Applicable Non-compliant The service is offered to the public as confirmed by the customer. The system is a notice service operated for the public (not private household use), and it processes notice records that are not temporary test records. Per the legal rule's applicability conditions, the retention duty applies to operators offering the notice service to the public, which this deployment satisfies. Not met The delete_expired method calculates record expiration using draft_timestamp instead of receipt_timestamp. Line 43 of service.py shows: 'notice.draft_timestamp + RETENTION_PERIOD <= now'. The RETENTION_PERIOD constant is set to 7 days (line 6). The legal rule requires retention for 7 days beginning at the receipt timestamp (when the notice is received, not when it is drafted). This implementation violates the requirement by using draft_timestamp as the retention period start point instead of receipt_timestamp. Met The notice text is preserved without modification during the retention period. The Notice dataclass is frozen (immutable, line 9 shows 'frozen=True'), which prevents any field modifications after instantiation. The receive method stores notice_text directly from the parameter into the Notice object (line 30). The database schema defines notice_text as TEXT NOT NULL (schema.sql line 3), with no triggers or transformations that would modify it. There is no code in the service that mutates notice_text after storage.

Private household use is excluded per the legal rule, and this is a public deployment. Temporary test records are handled via the is_temporary_test flag and excluded from retention processing as permitted by Article 3 exception. The 7-day period (RETENTION_PERIOD constant at line 6) is correct, but it is applied to the wrong timestamp. Exhaustive search confirmed no alternative receipt-timestamp-based deletion path exists in the repository. Met The notice_text is stored without modification. The receive method accepts notice_text as a parameter and stores it directly in the Notice dataclass (line 30) without any transformation, stripping, sanitization, or removal of content. The dataclass field is frozen (line 9), preventing post-creation modification. No text processing logic exists anywhere in the repository. The schema defines notice_text as TEXT NOT NULL, preserving the full content. Exhaustive search for text modification patterns found no matches.
